HideScenePaddingBorder.Name: Hide Scene Padding Border
HideScenePaddingBorder.Hint: Hide the black scene and canvas outlines for everyone in this world. Saving a change reloads connected clients.

StatusIconHeight.Name: Status Icon Height (%)
StatusIconHeight.Hint: Set each status icon's height as a percentage of its displayed token artwork. Try 4% for a modest increase, or 0% for Foundry's default sizing.

MinimumStatusIconSize.Name: Minimum Status Icon Size (px)
MinimumStatusIconSize.Hint: Set the smallest icon size in canvas pixels when percentage sizing is enabled. Set to 0 for proportional sizing without a minimum.

BrowserFavicon.Name: Browser Favicon
BrowserFavicon.Hint: Choose an image for the browser tab after signing in. Leave blank to use Foundry's usual icon.

BrowserTitle.Name: Browser Tab Title
BrowserTitle.Hint: Set the browser tab title after signing in. Leave blank to use Foundry's usual title.

TopAlignChatPortraits.Name: Top-Align Chat Portraits
TopAlignChatPortraits.Hint: Show the upper part of tall artwork in Character Chat Selector's sender portraits. Each player still chooses whether to show portraits.

CompactChatPortraits.Name: Compact Chat Portraits
CompactChatPortraits.Hint: Place the sender name beside the portrait in Character Chat Selector messages.

ResourcePanel.Drag: Drag to move the HP & MP panel

Show.Name: Show HP & MP Panel on Token Selection
Show.Hint: Automatically show the Project FU resource panel when you select a token you can edit.

ResourcePanel.NoTokens: Select a token to adjust its resources.
ResourcePanel.InvalidAmount: Enter a positive whole number or leave the amount blank to use 1.
ResourcePanel.Defeat: Set HP to zero. Shift-click to toggle defeated status. Right-click to change HP only.
ResourcePanel.Heal: Restore full HP. Right-click to change HP only.

hideMapPinBackground.Name: Hide Map Pin Backgrounds
hideMapPinBackground.Hint: Remove the built-in background behind map note icons.

alwaysShowMapPinLabels.Name: Always Show Map Pin Labels
alwaysShowMapPinLabels.Hint: Display the hover label on each map pin you can already see.

mapPinFontFamily.Name: Map Pin Label Font Family
mapPinFontFamily.Hint: Enter a font family available to your players. Leave blank to use each note's font.

mapPinFontSize.Name: Map Pin Label Font Size (px)
mapPinFontSize.Hint: Set a world-wide label size. Use 0 to keep each note's size.

mapPinTextColor.Name: Map Pin Label Text Color
mapPinTextColor.Hint: Leave blank to use each note's text color.

mapPinTextShadow.Name: Map Pin Label Drop Shadow
mapPinTextShadow.Hint: Use Foundry's default, add a drop shadow, or turn it off.

mapPinShadowColor.Name: Map Pin Label Shadow Color
mapPinShadowColor.Hint: Leave blank to use Foundry's usual shadow color.

mapPinStrokeWidth.Name: Map Pin Label Stroke Width (px)
mapPinStrokeWidth.Hint: Use -1 for Foundry's usual stroke, 0 to remove it, or a positive width for an outline.

mapPinStrokeColor.Name: Map Pin Label Stroke Color
mapPinStrokeColor.Hint: Leave blank to use Foundry's usual stroke color.

FontFamily.Name: Quest Popup Font Family
FontFamily.Hint: Enter a font family available to your players. Leave blank to use the usual popup font.

QuestMarkers.Name: Quest Marker
QuestMarkers.Hint: Hide the map label and open a popup from the linked text journal page on one click.
QuestMarkers.Empty: No quest details have been added.
QuestMarkers.MissingPage: Choose a Text journal page in this quest marker's Page field.

QuestRoutes.Title: Map Note Routes
QuestRoutes.LoopNeedsDistance: Choose at least two different locations to loop this route.
QuestRoutes.Picking: Click a location on the map to save the stop. Press Escape to cancel.
QuestRoutes.NoStops: Add stops in the order the marker should visit them.
QuestRoutes.NoNotes: Create a map note in this scene to set up a route.
QuestRoutes.OutsideMap: Choose a location inside the map.
QuestRoutes.SaveFailed: Could not save the map note route.

CanvasEffects.Title: Canvas Effects
CanvasEffects.CannotPlay: Could not load the WebM effect. Check that the file is accessible and has a playable duration.
CanvasEffects.NoScene: Open a scene you can edit to use Canvas Effects.
